### Solutions

**[id 0]**
* Eggs remaining after breakfast and muffins: $16 - 3 - 4 = 9$
* Daily earnings: $9 \times 2 = 18$

**[id 1]**
* Blue thread: $2$ reels
* White thread: $2 \div 2 = 1$ reel
* Total reels: $2 + 1 = 3$

**[id 2]**
* Total investment: $\$80{,}000 + \$50{,}000 = \$130{,}000$
* Value increase: $150\% \text{ of } \$80{,}000 = \$120{,}000$
* New house value: $\$80{,}000 + \$120{,}000 = \$200{,}000$
* Profit: $\$200{,}000 - \$130{,}000 = 70000$

**[id 3]**
* Total sprints per week: $3 \times 3 = 9$ sprints
* Total distance: $9 \times 60 = 540$ meters

**[id 4]**
* Total feed required for 20 chickens: $20 \times 3 = 60$ cups
* Feed provided morning and afternoon: $15 + 25 = 40$ cups
* Feed needed for the final meal: $60 - 40 = 20$ cups

**[id 5]**
* 16 glasses comprise 8 regular-priced glasses and 8 discounted glasses
* Price of discounted glass: $60\% \text{ of } \$5 = \$3$
* Total cost: $(8 \times \$5) + (8 \times \$3) = 40 + 24 = 64$

**[id 6]**
* Seattle: $20$ sheep
* Charleston: $4 \times 20 = 80$ sheep
* Toulouse: $2 \times 80 = 160$ sheep
* Total sheep: $20 + 80 + 160 = 260$

**[id 7]**
* Time for initial 40% (80 GB): $80 \div 2 = 40$ minutes
* Restart/update time: $20$ minutes
* Time for full restart download (200 GB): $200 \div 2 = 100$ minutes
* Total time: $40 + 20 + 100 = 160$ minutes

**[id 8]**
* Distance from home when turning around: $3 \times 60 = 180$ miles
* First 2 hours in traffic: $0$ miles
* Next 0.5 hour at 30 mph: $0.5 \times 30 = 15$ miles
* Remaining time ($4 - 2 - 0.5 = 1.5$ hours) at 80 mph: $1.5 \times 80 = 120$ miles
* Distance driven back: $15 + 120 = 135$ miles
* Distance remaining to home: $180 - 135 = 45$ miles

**[id 9]**
* Regular earnings for 40 hours: $40 \times \$10 = \$400$
* Overtime rate: $\$10 \times 1.2 = \$12/\text{hour}$
* Overtime earnings for 5 hours: $5 \times \$12 = \$60$
* Total earnings: $\$400 + \$60 = 460$
